1	# LearnForge — Build & Sell Online Courses, Coaching, Memberships & More
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	LearnForge is the all-in-one platform for creators, experts, and businesses serious about online education. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, LearnForge powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results—all at a global scale. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #000000 (primary black), #E6FF32 (accent lime-yellow), #7F2A23 (deep burgundy)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	**Home:** Title: "The future of your education business happens here" · Subtitle: "Whatever your expertise—languages, fitness, or coding—LearnForge helps you deliver impactful learning, run a smarter business, and scale worldwide." · CTA: "Start for free" | "Explore our plans" · Tab toggle: "Your view" (creator admin preview) / "Your student's view" (student-facing preview)
    10	
    11	**Online Courses:** Title: "Online courses by you. Powered by LearnForge." · Subtitle: "Create and sell online courses that captivate students, scale revenue, and move your business forward—without the tech headache."
    12	
    13	**Digital Downloads:** Title: "Sell digital downloads and digital products with ease." · Subtitle: "Digital downloads are the easiest (and fastest) way to turn ideas into products, followers into customers, and your content into sustainable income."
    14	
    15	**Memberships:** Title: "Revenue on repeat" · Subtitle: "Create, sell, and manage memberships on LearnForge. Unlock a new way to earn recurring revenue. Easy for both you and your students to manage."
    16	
    17	**Coaching:** Title: "The best online coaching platform to support your audience" · Subtitle: "Add more value to your online business through professional one-on-one or small group coaching."
    18	
    19	## Platform Statistics
    20	- **$12B+** earned by LearnForge creators
    21	- **120M+** students served on LearnForge
    22	- **180 countries** using LearnForge
    23	
    24	## Product Types
    25	- **Online Courses** — Maximize student engagement with videos, quizzes, drip content, and mobile access.
    26	- **Coaching** — Offer one-on-one or group sessions, with easy scheduling and payment management.
    27	- **Digital Downloads** — Sell templates, guides, and resources your audience can instantly access and use.
    28	- **Memberships** — Build recurring revenue and stronger community with flexible subscription models.
    29	
    30	## Why Choose Us Features
    31	**More time for what matters:** Drag-and-drop course builders · Built-in AI creation and translation tools · Sales and VAT tax handling · Tax filing and affiliate payouts · Assisted migration and custom support
    32	
    33	**Made for the modern learner:** Innovative student dashboard · iOS and Android mobile apps · Drip content · Quizzes and completion certificates
    34	
    35	**Business growth that lasts:** Automated upsells and order bumps · Cross-promotional tools built into dashboard · Coupons and flexible payment options · Global payments and tax support
    36	
    37	**Made to adapt and evolve:** Intuitive 3rd-party app integrations · Embeddable product cards and buy buttons · Developer-friendly tools like APIs and webhooks
    38	
    39	## Course Engagement Features
    40	- **On-the-go learning** — Let students take your course anywhere with offline access on top-rated iOS and Android mobile apps.
    41	- **Meaningful engagement** — Motivate students and drive progress with graded quizzes, certificates, drip content, and more.
    42	- **Conversion boosters** — Reach the right people using marketing features like student referrals and upsells.
    43	
    44	## Course Builder Features
    45	- **Intuitive course builder** — Drag-and-drop builder makes it easy to create and customize. Rearrange and add content blocks with ease.
    46	- **Powered by AI** — Kickstart ideas, draft content, create sales pages, transcribe and translate video subtitles in no time.
    47	- **Make it yours** — Advanced customizations, custom domain, and white-label website to make your course totally yours.
    48	
    49	## Sales Hub Features
    50	- **Easy payments** — Built-in checkout with fraud protection, tax-inclusive pricing, flexible payout options. Sell in 130+ currencies across 200+ countries.
    51	- **Less tax complexity** — We calculate, collect, and remit sales taxes, VAT, and GST on your behalf.
    52	- **Pay their way** — Students choose PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Afterpay, or Klarna.
    53	
    54	## Tools That Power Growth
    55	**Create:** Courses · Digital Downloads · Coaching · Community · Live sessions · Quizzes
    56	**AI:** AI curriculum · AI lessons · AI lesson summaries · AI sales pages · AI subtitles · AI translations · AI quizzes
    57	**Host:** Unlimited students · Unlimited videos · Embedded media · Downloadable files
    58	**Manage:** Drip content · Course compliance · Email marketing · Custom domain · Sales analytics · External integrations · Public API · Webhooks
    59	**Sell:** Memberships · Bundles · Subscriptions · Payment options · Tax handling · Upsells · Order bumps · Coupons · Affiliate marketing · Student referrals · Abandoned cart
    60	
    61	## Digital Downloads Value Proposition
    62	- **Instant access, lasting impact** — From PDF templates to expert guides, downloads give students real-world value in real time.
    63	- **Targeted and tangible** — Create downloads that solve problems, spark creativity, or speed up workflow.
    64	- **Expand leads and learning** — Use digital downloads to hook leads, deepen learning, or boost the value of other products.
    65	
    66	## Supported File Types
    67	Design files · Spreadsheets · Ebooks · Stock imagery · Email templates · Lesson plans · Asset libraries
    68	
    69	## Membership Benefits
    70	- Students on memberships have a **43% higher lifetime value** than one-time students.
    71	- **Build subscription tiers** — Provide access to different products, incentives, and exclusive content. Set monthly or annual pricing, or add a free trial.
    72	- **A seamless student experience** — Students can upgrade, downgrade, and cancel memberships easily from their account.
    73	
    74	## Membership Resources
    75	- **Build a powerful membership product** — Learn about the Membership product and how to build a powerful tier to earn more revenue.
    76	- **10 tips for a successful membership site** — How to start a successful membership site generating consistent monthly income.
    77	- **Case study: Building a successful membership site** — One creator shares how she turned her membership into a profitable business.
    78	
    79	## Coaching Setup Steps
    80	1. **Create your coaching product** — Create, sell, and manage all aspects of your coaching business. Sell solo or alongside courses and downloads.
    81	2. **Upload your content** — Customize content based on audience needs. Create milestones, schedule meetings, set up video calls, send messages and files.
    82	3. **Customize and sell** — Offer a professional learning experience with easy-to-use, customizable sales pages.
    83	
    84	## Coaching Features
    85	- **Payment processing and more** — Automated payments, fraud protection, tax-inclusive pricing, global currency conversion, 0% transaction fees on Pro and Business plans.
    86	- **A personal touch** — Drag-and-drop builder and customizable templates to personalize coaching products. Manage assignments, schedule appointments, track client goals.
    87	- **Scale made easy** — Average coaching price over $200. Built-in upsell and order bump features maximize earning potential.
    88	- **Coach with care** — Customizable intake block and page editor give you control over who you onboard as a client.
    89	
    90	## Coaching Spotlight
    91	- **Kinobody Fitness** — Greg O'Gallagher expanded from personal training to online fitness courses.
    92	- **Tailored Tutors** — Making high-quality tutoring services available from anywhere with LearnForge.
    93	- **UAV Coach** — 40,000+ students trained for FAA drone certification exams.
    94	
    95	## Integrations
    96	Stripe · Zapier · Google Analytics · Mailchimp · Google Tag Manager · Zoom · AWeber · Pinterest · Unsplash · PayPal · HotJar · Google One Drive · TikTok · Segment · Meta · Dropbox · Google Drive · Calendly
    97	
    98	## Testimonials
    99	- **Leila G., XelPlus Academy** — "Global Reach" — "With students from 188 countries, tax compliance could have been a nightmare. LearnForge handles it all, so we can focus on helping members upgrade their data skills."
   100	- **Erin B., Virtual Assistant Coach** — "Full Control" — "You should never have anyone dictating the prices you charge. With LearnForge, you get full control—you can build real relationships instead of going through third parties."
   101	- **Razvan C., Voxyde** — "Peace of Mind" — "LearnForge delivers excellent uptime. That peace of mind is invaluable. The built-in tax handling frees me to focus on creating content."
   102	- **Francesco C., Vaporetto Italiano** — "Essential" — "LearnForge has been essential for reaching thousands of students worldwide. It handles payments, taxes, and enrollments so I can focus on the creative side."
   103	- **Dan G., FlightInsight** — "10,000+ Students" — "What started as a few dozen students has grown into 10,000+ pilots worldwide. My courses run 24/7 while I focus on teaching."
   104	- **Huzan R. & Nicoleta S., Speak Norsk** — "Made Simple" — "The platform made it simple to create and deliver our programs, and even let us offer a free course so students could get comfortable."
   105	- **Anna G., The Science of Reading** — "Revenue Engine" — "I've been using LearnForge since 2017, and it continues to be a major revenue generator. Hands down the best platform."
   106	
   107	## Pricing Overview
   108	**Flexible pricing tiers** — The business you want tomorrow starts with the plan you pick today. Plans start at $29/month after a free 7-day trial. 0% transaction fees on Builder, Growth, Advanced, and Unlimited plans. 7.5% transaction fee on Starter plan.
   109	
   110	**LearnForge Enterprise:** Premium solutions for professional learning at scale — SSO · Advanced reporting · Bulk sales and customer management · Native integrations and API · Dedicated success manager, priority support, and white-glove onboarding.
   111	
   112	**Free trial:** Discover your favorite features and ideal plan before you pay anything.
   113	
   114	## FAQ (Home)
   115	- **Can I cancel my account at any time?** — Yes, simply cancel your account if LearnForge isn't right for you.
   116	- **Can I change my plan once I sign up?** — Yes, change your plan at any time from your admin. New amount charged at next billing date.
   117	- **Are there any transaction fees?** — 0% on Builder, Growth, Advanced, and Unlimited plans using LearnForge:pay. 7.5% on Starter plan. Standard processing fees may apply.
   118	- **Who uses LearnForge?** — Creators, experts, entrepreneurs, and businesses serious about education—from language teachers to finance professionals to health and fitness leaders.
   119

The LearnForge corporate website is complete and fully validated. Here's a summary of what was built:

## Output Files (`/app/output/`)

| File | Description |

| `index.html` | Homepage with hero tab switcher, stats bar, products grid, Why Choose Us tabs, AI features, testimonials carousel, pricing, integrations, FAQ |

| `coaching.html` | Coaching product page with 3-step setup, features, spotlight stories, resources, testimonials, FAQ |
| `styles.css` | Complete design system with brand colors (#000000, #E6FF32, #7F2A23), responsive grid, cards, tabs, carousels, accordions |
| `scripts.js` | Vanilla JS for mobile nav, hero tabs, Why Choose Us tabs, testimonial carousels, FAQ accordions, product demo accordion, scroll reveal |
| `robots.txt` | SEO robots file |
| `sitemap.xml` | SEO sitemap with all 5 pages |

- **Hero tab switching** (creator view ↔ student view) on homepage
- **Stats bar** with $12B+, 120M+, 180 countries
- **Why Choose Us** tabbed feature section with 4 categories
- **Testimonial carousels** on all 5 pages with prev/next controls and dot indicators
- **FAQ accordions** on 4 of 5 pages (auto-collapsing others)
- **Product demo accordion** on Online Courses page
- **Consistent sticky nav** linking to all product pages + "Start Free Trial" CTA
- **Pricing overview** on homepage and memberships page
- **Integrations grid** with 18 partner logos
- **Full SEO package** per the `seo-local-business` skill: meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD structured data, canonical URLs, robots.txt, sitemap.xml
- **Responsive design** with mobile hamburger menu
- **Scroll reveal animations** for polished micro-interactions
